candidate.answerReason: There are 22 - 12 + 1 = 11 reserved rows, each containing 33 seats, for a total of 363.

methods.label: Count the rows, then the seats
methods.explanation:
Both rows \(12\) and \(22\) are included. Subtracting their numbers counts \(22-12=10\) steps between rows, so there is one more row than steps: \(11\) reserved rows. Each has \(33\) seats, giving
\[11\cdot33=\boxed{363}\text{ seats},\]
choice \(\text{C}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses inclusive counting and whole-number multiplication.
